title: PR #8 — First-run setup wizard with atomic bootstrap guard
description: Implement `/setup` so the very first admin can be created exactly once, gated by BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN, with client-side key generation, recovery-key confirmation, and optional 2FA enrollment handoff. Requirement ID: TASK-18.
acceptanceCriteria: `/setup` is reachable only while `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users` is 0; otherwise it returns 409 and redirects to `/login`
Two concurrent setup requests produce exactly one user
A missing or wrong `BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN` returns 403 and creates no user
Refreshing mid-wizard creates no partial user
The wizard collects email, display name, and a master password of at least 12 characters
The recovery key is displayed once, must be confirmed by typing a substring, and is never sent to the server
After completion the session cookie is set and the user lands on an unlocked `/app`
An audit event records the bootstrap creation

steps.details: Create `app/lib/.server/bootstrap.ts` exposing `isBootstrapAvailable(db)` and `createFirstAdmin(db, input)`. Implement creation as a single statement: `INSERT INTO users (...) SELECT ... WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users)` and treat `meta.changes === 0` as 409. Do not rely on a separate count-then-insert.

Compare the submitted token to `env.BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN` with a constant-time comparison over equal-length buffers. Return 403 on mismatch without revealing whether the token is unset. Add rate limiting to this route in TASK-10; for now add a TODO comment referencing it.

steps.description: Build the wizard shell and steps
steps.details: Create `app/routes/setup.tsx` as a transport-only route plus the page entry `app/features/setup/setup.tsx` with `index.ts`. Wizard steps: token → account details → master password → recovery key confirmation → optional 2FA → done. Keep step state in a single reducer inside the feature, persist nothing to storage, and block navigation away with a confirm dialog once key material exists in memory.

On master-password submit, generate `kdfSalt`, derive `masterKey` and `authHash`, generate `vaultKey`, wrap it, generate the recovery secret, and wrap `vaultKey` with the recovery key. POST only the derived and wrapped values plus `kdf_iterations` and salts. Clear the password field immediately after derivation.

Create the `action` for `/setup` that validates input with Zod (email format, display name length, base64 field sizes), re-checks availability inside the atomic insert, stores the admin with `role='admin'`, `status='active'`, and issues a session using the TASK-8 session helper (import or stub the interface if TASK-8 has not merged).
Render the recovery-key component from TASK-6. On 2FA opt-in, route to the enrollment flow from TASK-9; if that task is not merged yet, offer a skip with the PRD warning text and a TODO reference.

steps.description: Test the guard and the happy path
steps.details: Vitest: concurrent `Promise.all` of two `createFirstAdmin` calls yields one row and one 409; wrong token yields 403; empty table check flips after creation. Playwright: complete the wizard, confirm the landing page is unlocked, reload `/setup` and confirm 409 redirect.

technicalNotes: The guard must be enforced in SQL, not in application logic; D1 is single-threaded per database but request interleaving still occurs.
Never return the submitted token, password, auth hash, or recovery secret in a response or log.
If TASK-8 (sessions) is not merged, define the session interface in this PR and let TASK-8 implement it, so PR #8 is not blocked.
The wizard must tolerate a failed network call without losing derived keys, but must not persist them to storage.
